cause.what_happened: TGL opened 8.1% up, then lost 32.8% intraday on 9.8x normal volume. The fall followed a 10:33 ET GlobeNewswire release: its subsidiary Tadaa Technology announced a 'strategic partnership' with Kainan Sdn Bhd to provide technology for a proposed $367m, 1,000-acre solar farm, with no stated binding terms or payment. The shape repeats 09-16/09-17: a $52m 'partnership' release, a spike to $3.51 on 4.4m shares, then a -37% day. No 8-K and no new filing sits behind either release, and I found no document naming today's seller.

findings.finding: An at-the-market agreement with Kingswood Capital Partners for up to $10,085,000 is open on live shelf 333-278171 (prospectus supplement 2026-02-03), and I found no termination filing. The issuer can sell stock into any 2026-09-23 bounce.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells continuously during the session, so a draw can happen on 2026-09-23 itself without any new filing first. The issuer has used this route before: an H.C. Wainwright ATM raised about $2.9m net through 2026-03-31, $2.5m was sold in the 12 months before the Feb-2026 supplement, and there was an Alumni Capital equity line. EDGAR full-text search for 'Kingswood' after 2026-02-05 returns only the two 10-Qs and no termination.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In December 2025 the name had a live takedown (424B5 2025-12-11, 424B3 2025-12-15) around a reverse split. Its falls then ran on: 12-08 -22% then -20.5%, 12-09 -20.5% then -40.0% (baseline events). The 2026 falls with no offering in progress (01-08, 06-11, 08-21, 09-17) were followed by -0% to +4%.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices what has already been sold, not what the ATM can add into a bounce tomorrow. The market cap is about $3.6m on 1.68m shares at the last disclosed count, so even a baby-shelf-limited draw of about $1-2m is a large share of float. If the market had fully priced continued ATM supply, the gap-and-fade pattern should show up as follow-through in this name's post-PR falls. It has not: 09-17 was +2.04% the next day.
